The previous Phase 12 Executor attempts made no repository changes: first the exact branch was created at d002180 but Java/Gradle/Android SDK were absent; second installation was blocked because its toolchain path was outside the writable workspace and PowerShell HTTPS failed. Continue on the existing clean branch feat/phase-12-android-companion at d002180. Install the authorized normal user-space Android toolchain inside the writable checkout at C:/Users/bielx/3D Objects/Dual-Codex-worktree/aip-phase10-checkout/.tooling/android (untracked, never committed): JDK 17, Android command-line tools, platform-tools, android-35/build-tools 35.0.0, and Gradle 8.9. Add minimum migration/contracts/Tauri/UI/docs/CI changes and focused Rust/TypeScript/Android tests. Preserve fixture paths, standalone operation, and Phase 13 BielOS metadata boundary. Run all Rust/contracts/desktop/Android/lint/build/integration/secrets/diff checks and commit only this scope with exact message `feat: implement phase 12 android companion`. Do not push, publish, create PR, merge, tag, release, deploy, modify BielOS, use native subagents, or edit directly outside the Executor.
constraints: Use only the configured Biel4 App Server Executor in fast mode; no native subagents or alternate backend.
Toolchain writes are limited to the explicit untracked .tooling/android path inside the checkout; never commit it or change system-wide state.
Produce a real buildable APK and authenticated transport; metadata-only or mock-only output is not acceptable.
No remote mutation, relay, public listener, telemetry, raw secret/media, Python runtime exposure, BielOS import, or safety weakening.
Preserve existing fixture and Rust/SQLite Owner/agent/safe-mode/temporary-chat/idempotency/audit gates.
